teknofest.name: Server name
teknofest.password.keep: Leave blank to keep the saved password
teknofest.password.required: Enter a password for this server
teknofest.transport_note: HTTP sends traffic without encryption. Use it only on a trusted network. HTTPS requires TLS to be enabled on the server; certificates are verified.
teknofest.profiles_hint: Connect servers independently and choose automatic connection per profile.
teknofest.history_description: Manage the local SQLite record of requests and responses sent to TEKNOFEST servers.
teknofest.history_retention_note: Records are not deleted automatically by default. JSONL exports can contain request/response data and should be treated as sensitive. The login request body containing the password is not stored in history.
teknofest.history_clear_confirm: All TEKNOFEST request history will be permanently deleted. This cannot be undone. Continue?
extension.siha_teknofest_server.name: SIHA Teknofest Server
extension.siha_teknofest_server.descript: Server connections, telemetry delivery and SQLite history
